reader.requirement: Format 2 ACCEPT must transfer the conceptual DATE, DAY, DAY-OF-WEEK or TIME value to identifier-2 by the rules of the MOVE statement, and those four names are conceptual items the program does not describe (so they are reserved and cannot be user data names).

edition-consulted.switches: refuses DATE YYYYMMDD / DAY YYYYDDD (accept-four-digit-year-2002, COBOL0815) and END-ACCEPT (end-accept-2002, COBOL0816) below 2002; the bare DATE / DAY / DAY-OF-WEEK / TIME forms pass through unchanged
the rows accept-four-digit-year-2002 and end-accept-2002 (introduced 2002) that the pass checks
DATE, DAY, DAY-OF-WEEK and TIME are reserved at 85, 2002, 2014 and 2023 alike, so a user item of those names is refused (COBOL0901)

reader.edition-search: grep for Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect|Construct in AcceptDisplayBinder.cs, AcceptDisplayEmitter.cs, BoundAccept.cs, AcceptSource.cs and MoveTable16.cs: the binder's ctx.Edition is only the diagnostic sink; the emitter, the conceptual-digit table and the runtime clock reads consult no edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f12_02 covers alphanumeric left/right, numeric truncation, edited, JUSTIFIED, group, signed, scaled and TIME zero fill; it does not exercise the refusal half (alphabetic or index receivers, a user item named DAY-OF-WEEK), a variable-length receiving group, or reference modification

probes.expected: the MOVE rules: edited insertion, high-order zero fill, alphanumeric right truncation, group as alphanumeric, JUSTIFIED RIGHT, sign generated, decimal alignment

probes.printed: RECGRP=[86359 ] (W-REC = 9 + X OCCURS 1 TO 5 DEPENDING ON W-N, W-N 3 before); RM=[****4**861]
probes.expected: a receiving group containing its ODO object uses its maximum length (§1985:VI.5.8.4 GR3b): 6 positions, 86359 then a space; the 3-character slice takes 861

probes.printed: error COBOL0818: ACCEPT receiver 'W-A': ... does not move to an alphabetic receiver
probes.expected: refused: the MOVE rules forbid a numeric integer into an alphabetic item

probes.printed: error COBOL0901: 'DAY-OF-WEEK' is a reserved word in COBOL-85 and cannot be used as a user-defined word
probes.expected: refused: the conceptual items are not described in the program

probes.printed: error COBOL0818: ACCEPT receiver 'W-I' is an index data item (class index)
error COBOL0815: ACCEPT FROM DATE YYYYMMDD / DAY YYYYDDD requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: refused: §1985:VI.6.5.2 format 2 lists bare DATE / DAY / DAY-OF-WEEK / TIME only

probes.printed: error COBOL0815 ... ACCEPT FROM DAY YYYYDDD
error COBOL0816: END-ACCEPT (explicit scope terminator) requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: refused at 85 (no END-ACCEPT in the 1985 format)

probes.printed: error COBOL2269: unexpected 'ON'. ACCEPT ON EXCEPTION ... specifies FROM
probes.expected: refused: format 2 has no exception phrase

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.5.4 GR6  (6.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR6 ["according to the rules for the MOVE statement"]
OK  §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR3b  (5.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3b ["If the group is a receiving item, the maximum length of the group will be used"]

reader.notes: The binder builds the conceptual item as a compiler temp and binds the transfer as MoveBinder.BindMoveOf's implicit MOVE, after asking MoveTable16.Validity, so every receiver class follows the one MOVE path. Class e (file organization) does not apply to ACCEPT. The same path runs at --std 2023 with identical output.
reader.at-2023: acc1.cob at --std 2023 prints the same lines

refuter.evidence: racc1.cob at --std 85 pinned 1986-12-25T14:41: P-scaled 999PPP FROM DATE holds 861 (W-P3/1000 = 0861 in a 9(4) COMP), PPP999 FROM DATE = 0, 9(4) COMP FROM DATE = 1225, 9 COMP FROM DAY = 9, alphanumeric-edited XBXBX FROM DAY = [8 6 3], BLANK WHEN ZERO 9(6) = 861225, SIGN LEADING SEPARATE = +861225, $$$,$$9 FROM DATE = $61,225, ***,**9 FROM DAY = *86,359, 9(3)/9(3) = 861/225, 99 FROM TIME = 00 (low-order truncation of 14410000), variable reference modification W-XS(W-IX:W-L) FROM DATE = AB86EFGH, subscripted table elements take 86359. Every result is the MOVE statement's for an unsigned integer sender. Refusals at 85: condition-name (COBOL1639), function-identifier (COBOL5506), every GnuCOBOL/Micro Focus source name (COBOL0817/5506/0307), END-ACCEPT (COBOL0816), DATE YYYYMMDD (rx14 COBOL0815). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.5.4 GR6 ["according to the rules for the MOVE statement"]. (DISPLAY of 999PPP prints 861000: a DISPLAY rule matter, not this one.)
